parsed_json.up: Select molecules reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1909294. Return molecule_chembl_id, pref_name as molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
